reference: Dummy workout seed data file for user validation; replace with open-licensed imports such as wger or free-exercise-db before production.
notes: Exercise choices are placeholders for product testing and persona walkthroughs.
Mappings connect aesthetic measurement deltas to likely muscle groups, not guaranteed outcomes.
Medical, injury, procedure-related, and pain-related routines require human review before use.
The seed is intentionally broad enough for account walkthroughs while keeping every item marked as non-production dummy data.

exercises.label: Dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep load modest enough to avoid swinging.
exercises.riskNotes: Avoid painful shoulder ranges; reduce load if traps dominate.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Lat pulldown
instructions: Start tall with ribs down and grip just outside shoulder width.
Pull elbows toward the ribs without leaning far back.
Control the stretch at the top of each rep.
exercises.riskNotes: Use a pain-free grip and avoid jerking from the shoulders.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a soft knee bend.
Lower until hamstrings limit the range, then stand tall.
Keep the load close to the body.
exercises.riskNotes: Not a rehab prescription; stop if low-back pain changes form.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Rear-foot elevated split squat
instructions: Set the rear foot on a bench and keep the front foot stable.
Lower under control until the front thigh is near parallel.
Drive through the front foot without bouncing.
exercises.riskNotes: Scale range of motion for knee or hip irritation.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Incline dumbbell press
instructions: Set a low incline and press dumbbells over the upper chest.
Let elbows track below the wrists.
Lower until the shoulders remain comfortable.
exercises.riskNotes: Use a neutral grip if shoulders feel pinchy.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Standing calf raise
instructions: Pause briefly in the stretched bottom position.
Rise onto the ball of the foot without bouncing.
Use a full pain-free range.
exercises.riskNotes: Progress slowly if Achilles tendon history exists.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit tall and start each rep with the shoulder blades reaching forward.
Pull elbows back without shrugging.
Pause briefly before returning with control.
exercises.riskNotes: Avoid yanking with the low back; reduce load if torso swing takes over.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Barbell hip thrust
instructions: Set the upper back on a bench with feet planted.
Drive hips up until torso and thighs form a straight line.
Control the lowering phase and keep ribs down.
exercises.riskNotes: Use padding and a stable bench; stop if low-back extension dominates.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Lying leg curl
instructions: Line the pad just above the heels.
Curl through a controlled range without lifting hips.
Lower slowly until the hamstrings are stretched.
exercises.riskNotes: Keep range pain-free around the knee; do not force end range.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Cable face pull
instructions: Set the cable around face height.
Pull the rope toward the face with elbows high.
Finish with shoulder blades squeezed without arching the back.
exercises.riskNotes: Keep load light enough to avoid neck strain.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold the weight close to the chest.
Sit down between the hips while keeping feet planted.
Stand up without bouncing out of the bottom.
exercises.riskNotes: Use a comfortable stance and reduce depth for hip or knee irritation.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Assisted pull-up
instructions: Start from a controlled hang with assistance set high enough for clean reps.
Pull chest toward the bar without kicking.
Lower until arms are long while shoulders remain comfortable.
exercises.riskNotes: Avoid painful overhead ranges and reduce range if shoulders pinch.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Pallof press
instructions: Stand sideways to the cable or band.
Press hands away from the chest without rotating.
Pause, then return with control.
exercises.riskNotes: Core work does not spot-reduce waist size; waist change is mainly diet, body weight, and measurement trend.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Incline dumbbell curl
instructions: Set a low incline and let arms hang comfortably.
Curl without moving the upper arm forward.
Lower slowly to a comfortable stretch.
exercises.riskNotes: Avoid aggressive stretching if elbows or biceps tendons are irritated.
exercises.sourceLicense: placeholder; replace with open-licensed exercise source

exercises.label: Rope triceps pressdown
instructions: Pin elbows near the sides.
Press the rope down until elbows straighten comfortably.
Return under control without letting shoulders roll forward.
exercises.riskNotes: Use a pain-free elbow range and avoid locking out aggressively.

muscleTargets.label: Shoulder width / delts
muscleTargets.rationale: Deltoid and upper-back work are the most direct trainable inputs for shoulder visual width.

muscleTargets.label: Waist contrast support
muscleTargets.rationale: Shoulder/back development can improve shoulder-to-waist contrast while waist change is mostly diet and measurement trend.

muscleTargets.label: Hip and thigh shape
muscleTargets.rationale: Glute, hamstring, and quad training are trainable contributors to hip and thigh circumference changes.

muscleTargets.label: Calf size
muscleTargets.rationale: Calf circumference is mostly tracked through direct calf training and body-weight context.

muscleTargets.label: Arm size
muscleTargets.rationale: Upper-arm and forearm circumference are trainable through elbow flexion, elbow extension, and pulling volume.

muscleTargets.label: Upper back posture support
muscleTargets.rationale: Rows and rear-delt work can support upper-back development and more repeatable posing without claiming structural change.
